from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api')
def api():
    # Obtener los parámetros de la URL
    data = request.args.to_dict()
    
    # Obtener el valor del campo 'nombre' o devolver "Desconocido" si no existe
    nombre = data.get('nombre', 'Desconocido')
    
    return nombre

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api', methods=['GET'])
def api_route():
    # Obtenir le paramètre de charge utile de l'URL
    payload = request.args.to_dict()
    
    # Charger la charge utile dans un dictionnaire (déjà fait par request.args.to_dict())
    # Récupérer la valeur du nom du dictionnaire
    name = payload.get('name', 'Inconnu')
    
    # Afficher le nom dans la console
    print(f"Nom reçu : {name}")
    
    # Renvoyer la valeur du nom
    return jsonify({'name': name})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
import json

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api', methods=['POST'])
def handle_payload():
    # Get payload from URL (assuming it's sent as JSON in request body)
    payload = request.get_json()
    
    # Load payload into dictionary
    if not payload:
        return jsonify({"error": "No payload provided"}), 400
    
    # Extract 'name' value from dictionary
    name_value = payload.get('name')
    
    if not name_value:
        return jsonify({"error": "No 'name' field in payload"}), 400
    
    # Copy the name value
    copied_name = name_value
    
    # Print the name value
    print(f"Name value: {name_value}")
    
    # Return the name value to the client
    return jsonify({"name": copied_name})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)

from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api')
def api():
    # URL'den yük parametresini al
    data = request.args.to_dict()
    
    # Sözlükten name değerini al, yoksa "Anonymous" döndür
    name = data.get('name', 'Anonymous')
    
    return name

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
